text: {"assertions":["A listener that was registered but never removed during teardown caused a malformed record bug in ingest/pipeline/parser.py.","The malformed record bug only occurred on the first request after a cold start.","The bug could be reproduced by feeding a mixed-encoding sample file to the parser.","The bug manifested as a decode error pointing to a specific byte offset.","Fixing the bug by removing the listener on teardown reduced p99 latency from 4.7 seconds to 978 milliseconds.","The fix included adding a test assertion to verify the listener is properly removed on teardown.","The fix was submitted as PR #4503 on the fix/malformed-record-1 branch.","The malformed record bug was located in the same area of ingest/pipeline/parser.py as previous similar work, allowing context to carry over."]}
